QuestInfo.name: Status of Heliseum Reclamation HQ
QuestInfo.0: Figuring out the current status of the Heliseum Reclamation HQ and determining the next step are the highest priority. Talk to #p3001000# to hatch a plan.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p3001000##k tells you that the Heliseum Reclamation HQ has taken a big hit. Talk to  #b#p3001001##k about driving out the army of Specters.
QuestInfo.2: #p3001001# said that he was waiting for Kaiser. Get the detailed story from #p3001001#.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 70,725
Can proceed to the Out With the Scout quest

0.0: Hello, Kaiser. I know you can often be a bit punch-drunk, so allow me to remind you. I am #p3001000#, supreme commander of the Nova. The irony of your fight to reclaim the Heliseum Reclamation HQ is not lost on me. Allow me to fill you in.\r\n#L0##b(Whoa, #p3001000# is gorgeous, but she sounds so cold! Like an ice sculpture. A really pretty ice sculpture.)#l\n#k
0.1: This isn't the first time we've dealt with a large-scale Specter force. The casualties have been more than acceptable, but our supplies are running thin...\r\n#L0##bSounds like a recipe for bad stuff. That's why I came down to even the odds.#l\n#k
0.2: YOU are here to help us reestablish our foothold here, something we cannot do with errant Specters roaming the streets. I want you to go speak with #p3001001#. He will give you your assignment.

yes.0: Talk to #b#p3001001##k. He's standing right over there.

no.0: Yes, I'm sure you have far more important matters than the future of your own race...

1.0: Kaiser! I've been waiting for you. We've got heads to bust.
1.1: Our supply routes are all blocked up with Specter trash. We need to clear them out on the double.
1.2: Give me a minute to get the maps together and I'll show you where to go.

default.0: #b#p3001001##k has your assignment. He's standing right there.
